# Sustain 2.0.3
This update improves audio-output isolation, saves song and rehearsal edits more reliably, and adds a way to restart audio without rebuilding your setup.
## Audio routing and recovery
- Pad and metronome single-channel routes now use explicit output-channel maps instead of pan controls. Unselected outputs are silenced, and stereo pads are folded to mono when assigned to a single output. - Playback checks the selected device and channel mapping before activation and after engine startup, including after audio preparation. Detected routing mismatches stop playback rather than continuing on an unexpected output. - **Restart Audio** is available in Audio Settings. It stops playback, rebuilds the audio connection, and reapplies your selected devices and channels. Your output settings are kept, playback remains stopped, and the screen shows the restored routes or an error. **Refresh Devices** remains available to rescan hardware.
## Saving and persistence
- Song BPM edits save even when the tempo input still has focus. - Rehearsal beat accents, countoff choices, and click-sound settings persist across launches, along with tempo, meter, pulse interpretation, and subdivision. Playback itself is never restored automatically. - Failed song saves keep the editor open and retain the edit for retrying. Repeated save attempts do not create duplicate songs. - Retrying a failed tempo-default save now keeps the requested BPM. - Libraries that cannot be recovered remain protected across relaunches instead of being mistaken for a new installation and replaced with the starter library. - A failed rehearsal click update no longer freezes countoff progress. Failed replacement activation clears the playback state so it can be restarted.
## Verification still needed
The reported intermittent click bleed on a Focusrite Scarlett motivated these routing changes. Automated audio-sample tests and local device checks pass, but **physical isolation on the Scarlett has not yet been verified**, and the exact cause of the original incident has not been established.
Before using this update in a service, rehearse with your interface and confirm that pad and metronome reach only their assigned outputs. For the reported setup, check **Pad → Output 2** and **Metronome → Output 1**, including after relaunching or reconnecting the interface. Use **Restart Audio** if the audio connection behaves unexpectedly, then verify the outputs before resuming playback.
The release still needs physical Scarlett output recordings and an end-to-end update check on the installed signed build. Physical Intel hardware, external MIDI controllers, and assistive-technology workflows have not been manually validated for this release. Automated tests do not replace these hardware checks.
## Updating
Use **Sustain → Check for Updates…**, or download the disk image and drag Sustain into Applications. Requires macOS 14 or newer. Official downloads are signed and notarized Universal 2 apps for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

# Sustain 2.0.2
A maintenance release focused on reliable playback and a clearer installation experience.
## Installation
The disk image now opens with large Sustain and Applications icons, a clear drag arrow, and a designed background explaining how to install and open the app.
## Playback and routing
- Click accent levels are more distinct: Soft is quieter, and Strong now weights the in-between subdivision clicks as well as the main beat. Strong and Normal main-beat levels and spoken count-in levels stay the same.
- Stop fades pads to silence before stopping their players, including both voices during a song crossfade. - Rehearse volume, click accent, and countoff sound stay separate from Live settings. - Routing is restored before idle restarts and checked for device, channel, and sample-rate changes. Detected routing faults stop playback with a message so the operator can check outputs and restart intentionally. - Rehearse blocks playback on unavailable routes. Failed audio activation no longer leaves an untracked pad playing, and audible pre-roll entries cannot be deleted.
## Library and MIDI fixes
- Pad undo/redo preserves later song edits and catalog changes. - Libraries saved by a newer app version are preserved rather than replaced with older backups when their format changes. - Custom-pad relinking handles concurrent reordering and renaming. - Quick MIDI CC presses retain their press/release edges, and overlapping Any Controller/device-specific mappings are rejected.
## Updating
Use **Sustain → Check for Updates…**, or download the disk image and drag Sustain into Applications. Requires macOS 14 or newer. Official downloads are signed and notarized Universal 2 apps for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
## Testing scope
Automated regression tests cover the fixes above. The intermittent live report of pads and click sharing an output has not been reproduced with a physical interface; these fixes do not establish its cause. External audio interfaces, physical MIDI controllers, Intel hardware, assistive-technology workflows, and this release's end-to-end Sparkle update still require manual validation. Check routing and rehearse with your performance hardware before a service.

# Sustain 2.0.0
Sustain 2.0 refreshes the Live and Rehearse screens with a consistent visual system while keeping the performance controls and keyboard shortcuts familiar.
Advanced click settings now support per-song subdivisions, beat accents and mutes, grouped pulses for compound meters, and zero-, one-, or two-bar count-ins. Rehearse has independent click settings. A count-in-only option stops the click after the count-in while pads continue. Tap tempo is available in Rehearse and for a cued Live song; a Live tempo stays in the current session until saved as the song default.
Live and Rehearse include clearer route information, pending click changes, and explicit warnings when required outputs are unavailable. Custom pads and optional MIDI controller mappings remain available.
## Before a service
Check pad and click routing in Settings, run System Check, and rehearse the setlist with the audio devices and MIDI controller you will use live.
This release requires macOS 14 or newer. Official downloads are signed and notarized Universal 2 apps for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
## Testing scope
The signed 1.1.2 → 2.0 Sparkle update was exercised on an Apple silicon Mac, including installation, relaunch, and migration of a test library. Apple silicon and Intel CI and Universal 2 package checks passed. Physical Intel hardware, USB/Bluetooth MIDI controllers, external audio interfaces and file locations, Live/Rehearse playback on representative hardware, assistive-technology workflows, and updater failure paths have not completed manual QA for this release.
## Updating to 2.0
If you have 1.1.2 installed, use **Sustain → Check for Updates…** to update to 2.0. Automatic checks are optional, and installing always requires your choice. Sustain 1.1.1 contains an updater activation bug, so first install 1.1.2 from its disk image. Older versions also require a manual disk-image install.
